records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended March 31, 2023 and 2022, we recognized passenger revenue of $858 million and $693 million, respectively, that was included in passenger travel liability at the beginning of the respective periods.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total 401(k) company match, Retirement Plus, Retirement Advantage, pilot retirement contribution, and profit sharing expensed for the three months ended March 31, 2023 and 2022 was $66 million and $62 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This was recorded as an expense within special items in the first quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our first quarter 2023 results were characterized by strong operational performance with higher revenue and better cost efficiency compared to the same period in 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •First quarter system capacity increased by 9.0% compared to the first quarter of 2022.
